messages.text:
The first frequency generator still left equal-count tails when `--limit 0`, so exact ordering remained tied to the reference’s internal hash order.

I’m changing the generated valid frequency fixtures to give every value a unique count, preserving exact oracle comparison without relying on unstable tie ordering.
